affixes.name: Thorns
affixes.description: Adjacent hits on it (tomes too, and your counters) send 25% of the damage back, rounded down: hits of 3 or less send nothing; crits and overkill count. Never kills: leaves you at 1 HP.
affixes.narrativeHint: A crackling aura of pain surrounds this enemy.
affixes.forecastText: Reflects {reflectMeleePctPercent}% of adjacent hit damage; cannot kill

affixes.name: Regenerator
affixes.description: Heals 20% max HP at start of enemy phase
affixes.narrativeHint: Wounds close unnaturally fast on this enemy.

affixes.name: Venomous
affixes.description: After combat, if it landed a hit, deals 5 more damage once to its target. Cannot kill: leaves at least 1 HP.
affixes.narrativeHint: A sickly green haze clings to this enemy weapon.
affixes.forecastText: +{poisonDamage} after combat if it hits; cannot kill

affixes.name: Rally
affixes.description: Nearby enemies within 2 tiles gain +3 ATK
affixes.narrativeHint: This enemy presence emboldens those nearby.

affixes.name: Waller
affixes.description: At start of enemy phase, spawns a temporary Wall tile on a random adjacent empty tile (lasts 2 turns)
affixes.narrativeHint: The ground buckles and rises around this enemy.

affixes.name: Teleporter
affixes.description: After taking damage, warps to a random passable tile within 3 spaces
affixes.narrativeHint: This enemy flickers and its position seems uncertain.
affixes.forecastText: Warps up to {warpRange} tiles after damage

affixes.name: Shielded
affixes.description: First hit each player phase deals 0 damage
affixes.narrativeHint: A translucent barrier shimmers around this enemy.

affixes.name: Berserker
affixes.description: +5 ATK, -3 DEF. Prioritizes attacking the weakest nearby unit
affixes.narrativeHint: This enemy eyes burn with frenzied rage.

affixes.name: Deathburst
affixes.description: On death, deals 5 damage to every adjacent unit, allies and enemies alike. Can kill.
affixes.narrativeHint: Dark energy pulses within this enemy.
affixes.forecastText: On death: {aoeDamage} damage to adjacent units; can kill

affixes.name: Anchored
affixes.description: Cannot be moved by Shove or Pull. +2 DEF on Fort or Throne terrain
affixes.narrativeHint: This enemy is rooted to its position.

affixes.name: Corrosive
affixes.description: After combat, if it landed a hit, reduces target DEF by 2 once for the rest of battle. Stacks across combats.
affixes.narrativeHint: Acid drips from this enemy weapon.
affixes.forecastText: {debuffValue} {debuffStat} after combat if it hits; stacks across combats

affixes.name: Grievous
affixes.description: After combat, if it landed a hit, leaves the target Wounded for 2 turns: it recovers no HP except from a staff.
affixes.narrativeHint: Barbed edges on this enemy weapon leave wounds that will not close.

affixes.name: Haste
affixes.narrativeHint: This enemy moves with unnatural speed.

exclusions.reason: Cannot be both mobile and immovable
Stacking damage negation with regen is too strong

visualIndicator.note: Affixed enemies should display a pip indicator and affix tooltip in inspection UI.
